summary: Alpha Compute Corp, a British Virgin Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its board unanimously approved Amendment No. 3 to its Amended and Restated 2021 Equity Incentive Plan on September 30, 2026, on recommendation of the Compensation Committee. The amendment raises the reserve to 1,070,127 shares, of which 387,727 are a Special Share Allocation tied to at least two of time-based vesting, share-price milestones, and premium-multiple option exercise prices. The board may annually increase the limit by up to 4% of shares outstanding; an S-8 registration is authorized. This is a routine equity-plan amendment, not a special situation; watch dilution and milestone design.
